instruction: Open https://public.purolator.com/estimate?lang=en, Purolator's Estimate Time & Cost tool. Get an estimate for one piece in your own packaging weighing 5 lb, shipped from postal code M5S 2H7 to postal code H3B 4W8 in Canada. Leave dimensions, protection and other options unset. The outcome is the request for the estimate; shipping is not required.
